item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00015","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C17","C07","C15"],"selected_candidate_label":"C17","confidence":0.99,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C17 is a direct and material drafting template for the child. Both memoranda follow the same compact sequence: announce the annual nationwide appeals among Federal civilian and military personnel; identify the Red Cross, USO, and disease-fighting organizations; state the fundraising target; declare the Government's desire to assume its share of support; describe the campaigns as an opportunity to support voluntary organizations; appoint a Cabinet secretary as Federal vice chairman; and request full cooperation. Much of the child's wording is copied or lightly revised from C17. C07 and C15 are also close predecessors in the same memorandum series, but their longer administrative provisions and wording are less directly reflected in the child.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"United funds and Community Chests will soon be making their annual appeals throughout the country and among federal civilian and military personnel.","parent_excerpt":"This fall, United Funds and Community Chests make their annual appeals across the land and among Federal civilian and military personnel","explanation":"Nearly verbatim opening formulation, with only minor changes in timing and geography wording."},{"child_excerpt":"Many of these campaigns include such national charities as the Red Cross, USO, and others working to eliminate disease and secure the health of us all.","parent_excerpt":"These include such national agencies as the Red Cross, USO, and those working to eliminate disease and secure the health of us all.","explanation":"Distinctive enumeration and the exact phrase about eliminating disease and securing health are reused."},{"child_excerpt":"We, in Government, want to assume our full share of the support of private health and welfare services.","parent_excerpt":"We, in Government, want to assume our full share of support of the many private health and welfare organizations","explanation":"The child's central appeal closely reproduces C17's language and sentence structure."},{"child_excerpt":"The United fund and Community Chest campaigns provide each of us with an opportunity to participate in a wide variety and number of voluntary organizations.","parent_excerpt":"The United Fund and Community Chest campaigns provide us with an opportunity for exercising the traditional American quality of neighborliness.","explanation":"The same campaigns-provide-an-opportunity sentence frame is retained and adapted."},{"child_excerpt":"The Honorable Neff H. McElroy, Secretary of Defense, will serve as Vice Chairman of United Community Campaigns for the federal Government. I am sure everyone will extend full cooperation to him","parent_excerpt":"The Honorable Marion B. Folsom, Secretary of Health, Education, and Welfare, will serve as Vice Chairman for the Federal Government of United Community Campaigns. Under the recently adopted Federal policy on voluntary fund-raising, I am confident everyone will extend full cooperation to the Vice Chairman","explanation":"The same appointment-and-cooperation machinery and closely parallel language are reused with a different Cabinet officer."}]}
